## Per-topic evaluation (ROBUST04 qrels_50_Queries) — CE: approach3_ce_kfold_old/fold_0

**What this doc contains**: per-topic Recall and AP (used for MAP) for:
- **BM25**: Recall@5000 and AP@1000
- **BM25+RM3 (50/50/0.2)**: Recall@5000 and AP@1000
- **BM25+RM3 + Cross-Encoder (old)**: AP@1000 and Recall@1000 (final ranked list)

**Important notes**:
- “MAP per topic” is **AP**; MAP is the mean of AP over topics.
- CE is applied as a **reranker** on top of RM3 candidates (rerank depth 500, blend α=0.2).

### Overall (50 topics)

- **BM25 MAP@1000**: 0.2455
- **BM25+RM3 MAP@1000**: 0.2352
- **BM25+RM3+CE(old) MAP@1000**: 0.2428
